MiDash AI is a canonical import sample prepared from a There's An AI For That detail page. This record is intended for import workflow testing, field mapping verification, and later editorial enrichment. The current sample already includes the real source detail URL, logo URL, screenshot URL, and DOM locations used during extraction. Overview and Releases body paragraphs are not yet populated because the detail page content still needs a follow-up browser-based capture or manual copy from the source page.

Overview: MiDash 2.1 is live, and we rebuilt it around three things traders actually asked for. First, a new Bring Your Own AI plan that lets you plug your existing OpenAI or Anthropic subscription into MiDash for unlimited usage and unlimited backtesting, with no token markups and no throttling, your subscription and your rules. Second, a major upgrade to our Scanner Agents, point them at any US-listed ticker and they pull 1-minute candle patterns, scan 2+years of history for similar setups, and rank them by outcome, so you can describe a pattern in plain English and find every time it has printed since 2024. Third, a full-time support agent on-call 24/7 that answers in seconds, and escalates to a human when it should. TAAFT-exclusive, use code TAAFT for 15% off, recurring every cycle, with a 7-day free trial and no card required. midash.ai/taaft
